title: Education
description: content/data/education.json: degrees shown in the Education section and on the resumes. Array of entries, newest first.

degree.description: Degree, e.g. "Ph.D." or "Bachelor of Science". Shown as a badge.

start.description: Start (or a label such as "Enrolled: Sep 2026"). Free text, shown as written (e.g. "Sep 2024", "2023", "Present").

end.description: End or expected end. Leave empty ("") to show only start. Free text, shown as written (e.g. "Sep 2024", "2023", "Present").

gpa.description: GPA shown on the website (e.g. "3.9"). Also used on the resumes as gpa/gpa_scale unless resume_gpa is set; an empty string hides it on the resumes.

description.description: Extra line, e.g. "Advisor: Prof. Ada Advisor" or coursework.

resume_degree.description: Degree text for the resumes. Defaults to "<degree>, <major>". LaTeX: & % _ $ are escaped automatically unless already escaped; other LaTeX commands (e.g. \\textbf{...}) pass through.

resume_gpa.description: GPA text for the resumes, e.g. "3.9/4.0". Overrides gpa and gpa_scale.

gpa_scale.description: Scale appended to gpa on the resumes. Default "4.0".

resume_end.description: End date text for the resumes. Defaults to end. "Ongoing" prints "Expected: <end>".

resume_details.description: Raw text appended after the university on the resumes, e.g. ", \\textit{with Honors}".

show_on_website.description: Set to false to hide the degree on the website.
